**Key findings:**

- **Cassis has exactly one Michelin-starred restaurant: [La Villa Madie](https://lavillamadie.com/en/) (★★★)** — no 2-star restaurants exist in Cassis or Marseille; the region jumps from 1-star straight to 3-star.
- La Villa Madie earned its 3rd star in 2022; chef Dimitri Droisneau; menus €195–€380; open Thu–Sun (extended Mon in summer).
- Sister bistro **Brasserie du Corton** (opened 2024, ≈€70) is the accessible fallback at the same clifftop location.
- Nearest 3-star alternatives if La Villa Madie is full: **Le Petit Nice Passedat** and **AM par Alexandre Mazzia** (both Marseille, ~25 min), and **La Table du Castellet** (~35 min, under new chef since Oct 2024).
